department: Life Science Zurich Graduate School (UZH and ETH Zurich; 16+ PhD programs)

deadline.value: Two rounds a year (1 May, 1 November); 1 November 2026 is the first round usable for Fall 2027 entry. Start date is agreed with the supervisor.
deadline.quote: Our deadlines are 1 May (23:59 CEST) and 1 November (23:59 CET).

also.quote: Accepted students may start their PhD and the PhD program any time of the year.

supervisor.value: You apply to the graduate school, not to a group leader; contacting group leaders is not recommended. Invited candidates then see open positions.
supervisor.quote: No. It is neither necessary nor recommended to contact group leaders individually.

funding.value: Research groups pay PhD students a salary based on the SNSF rates.
funding.quote: Research groups within the Life Science Zurich Graduate School provide financial support for PhD students employed at the University of Zurich

also.quote: Our funded positions are open for national and international (also non-EU) students.

entry_route.value: A Master's degree or equivalent is required; an Indian bachelor's (B.Tech/B.Sc Hons) is not accepted.
entry_route.quote: Unfortunately, our universities do not consider a Bachelor's Degree/B.Tech/B.Sc (Hons) as equivalent to a Masters and therefore an application is not possible.

gre_general.value: The graduate school does not ask for a GRE.
gre_general.quote: At present, the LSZGS does not ask for a GRE test.

toefl_min.value: No English test is mandatory, though a certificate is recommended.
toefl_min.quote: A formal proof of competence in English (IELTS, CPE or TOEFL) is recommended but not mandatory.

ielts_min.value: No English test is mandatory, though a certificate is recommended.
ielts_min.quote: A formal proof of competence in English (IELTS, CPE or TOEFL) is recommended but not mandatory.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

notes: Umbrella for Ecology, Evolutionary Biology, Plant Sciences, Biomedicine, Cancer Biology, Microbiology and Immunology, Epidemiology and Biostatistics and others. FAQ says the graduate school charges no fee but also that UZH charges PhD students CHF 100, so the UZH fee is inherited. Neuroscience has its own record.
